headline: When Should I Hire a Pro for Finish Carpentry Coordination?
articleBody: Coordinating finish carpentry can feel like conducting an orchestra, and knowing when to bring in a professional conductor makes a big difference. You should definitely consider professional help when your job involves multiple trades working in tight spaces or under strict deadlines. The more moving parts there are—cabinets, flooring, painting, electrical—the more crucial expert coordination becomes to keep everything in sync and avoid costly delays. If your project includes custom details or stain-grade work, where any imperfection will be highly visible, a professional's eye for sequencing and quality control is invaluable. High-visibility areas like kitchens and bathrooms, which are our specialty in Berkeley and the East Bay, also benefit immensely from a pro who ensures fit, finish, and punch-list quality truly impact the result positively. We take on only one project at a time and are very hands-on to ensure quality. If you're feeling overwhelmed by the intricate dance of trades or aiming for a flawless, high-end result, that's your sign to seek out a trusted partner who can handle the intricacies for you. Reach out to Frasheski Construction to discuss your project; we're happy to help.
